verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a GitHub connection, repository sync, or two-way change flow for Figma Make. The pack shows only in-app code editing, change review, version history, and that generated code lives inside the Make project, none of which is repo sync. Community reports describe reverse-engineering the undocumented .make format to get code out, which further suggests no first-party GitHub export.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sync my project to my own GitHub repository and keep changes flowing both ways
